title: Sabah Rutini
content: Every morning, I wake up at six o'clock. I brush my teeth and take a shower. Then I have breakfast with my family. I usually drink tea and eat bread with cheese. After breakfast, I leave home at seven thirty. I take the bus to work. The journey takes about forty minutes. I have been working at the same company for three years. My colleagues are friendly and helpful. During lunch break, I sometimes read a book or practice English vocabulary. In the evening, I study grammar and tenses because I want to improve my English quickly.

title: İlk Seyahat
content: Last summer, I visited London for the first time. I had never been to England before, so I was very excited. When I arrived at the airport, I realized that I had forgotten my umbrella. It was raining heavily, but I didn't mind. I had been planning this trip for months. During my stay, I visited many famous places. I saw Big Ben and walked along the Thames. The people were kind, although the weather was often cold and cloudy. By the end of the week, I had learned many new words and gained confidence in speaking English.

title: Gelecek Planları
content: Next year, I will start a new language course. I have been thinking about this decision for a long time. By the end of next year, I will have completed the advanced level. I am sure that I will be speaking more fluently by then. My teacher says that if I practice every day, I will have made significant progress within six months. I am planning to travel abroad as well. While I am traveling, I will be using English every day. I believe that practice is the most important factor in language learning.

title: Hata Yapmak Normal
content: Many students are afraid of making mistakes when they speak English. However, mistakes are a natural part of learning. I used to feel embarrassed when I used the wrong tense, but now I understand that errors help me improve. My teacher always corrects me gently. She has been teaching English for fifteen years, and she knows that patience is essential. When I review my error pool regularly, I notice that I repeat fewer mistakes. Although grammar is difficult, I am becoming more confident every week.

title: Kısa Hikaye
content: Tom was a young engineer who lived in a small town. He worked hard every day, but he dreamed of traveling the world. One day, his company offered him a position abroad. He had never lived in another country before. He accepted immediately. While he was packing his bags, his phone rang. It was his best friend, who had been waiting for this news. They talked for an hour. Tom felt happy and nervous at the same time.
